_comment: Gameplay presets for the server config generator. Each fills default.cfg; `server` lines go to server.cfg.
`default` entries are [cvar, value, note] or {"section": title}. `flow` suggests the game-flow step's starting values.
Every preset sets OpenJK's four legacy fixes explicitly, except the bundled one, which keeps the Docker image's file.
Sources: base-like and JA+-like come from the saber feel and force powers audits in the config generator design doc,
which compared jaPRO with the Jedi Academy MP SDK, retail jampded 1.011 and JA+ 2.4 Build 7, and took values from
a real base server's configs and a real JA+ server's configs. The base presets come from the same base server.

japro.label: Bundled
japro.summary: The Docker image's default.cfg: jaPRO's tweaks, race mode, unlagged weapons and fast force regeneration.

japro.label: Close to base
japro.summary: Base Jedi Academy sabering: SP-style damage, no jaPRO tweaks, no private duels, force limited to jumping and saber skills, and no race mode.
server: The base server's frame rate; retail defaulted to 20

default.section: Saber and force: take base's code paths

default: No friction while standing on a player, as in base

default.section: Base bugs kept fixed: they don't change combat

default: Keeps the crouch fix: base lets players stand up into curved ceilings
Keeps moving a player who stops sending commands; base froze them, even in mid-air

default.section: OpenJK legacy fixes: off, except the dual-saber disarm buff

default: Kept on: counts the second saber's disarm bonus
Base's torso animation while the saber is thrown
Jump, saber offense and saber defense only

default.section: Pickups: no health or shields, no force items

notes: Not matched by any setting: legs sticking on slopes. Kept fixed on purpose: standing up into a ceiling after a crouch or roll, and lagging players freezing in place.

Base servers send each player's movement for clients to extrapolate up to 50 ms; jaPRO sends plain positions, so other players can look a little behind. This only changes what players see, not where hits land.

japro.label: Close to JA+
japro.summary: A standard JA+ server's saber and force settings translated to jaPRO: MP damage, JA+-style kicks, rolls and hook, and instant force regeneration.
server: JA+ servers ran retail jampded at 30
default: Keep MP damage in private duels too
No MP damage interpolation (1) and JA+'s improved yellow DFA (512)
Push and pull reach knocked-down players (4), fast grip (128), push and pull move items (256)
Needed for private duels to start with armor
Armor at the start of duel gametypes

default.section: OpenJK legacy fixes: off, as in JA+

notes: Not emulated: JA+'s MP damage table and its returning-swing contact, lightning and drain timing, jp_fixAbsorb, JA+'s SP attacks and force animations, the alternate dimension, and JA+'s admin ranks.
jp_gripOpenSaber 3 has only an approximate equivalent, g_fixSaberInGrip, so it is left at jaPRO's default.

JA+ servers send each player's movement for clients to extrapolate up to 50 ms; jaPRO sends plain positions, so other players can look a little behind. This only changes what players see, not where hits land.

base.label: Saber team FFA
base.summary: A base server's rules: sabers only, force limited to jumping and saber skills, no health or shield pickups, friendly fire on.
default: Jump, saber offense and saber defense only

default.section: Pickups: no health or shields, no force items

base.label: Defaults
base.summary: Nothing: the game module's own defaults.

other.label: The mod's own defaults
other.summary: The generator writes engine settings and base cvars only; add the mod's own settings as free-form lines.
